g.text: Class 10 CS | Ch 1 | T 1.3 Process Management
1. Creation - user starts a program; OS loads code into memory and assigns CPU + resources.
2. Execution - process runs its instructions and performs the user's task.
3. Termination - user closes it or task ends; OS reclaims memory and CPU.
4. Freed resources return to a shared pool so other processes can use them.
5. Every running program (Chrome, Word, VLC) walks through the same three stages.
